name: Aura of Terror
body:
Your aura of cowardice becomes more potent, as your incredible menace is amplified.

Prerequisite(s): Aura of cowardice class feature, caster level 8th.

Benefit(s): Your aura of cowardice expands to a 20-foot-radius emanation. Enemies within the aura who have to make a save vs. fear effect must roll their save twice and keep the worst result.

Normal: The aura of cowardice affects each enemy within a 10 feet and grants them a -4 penalty to saving throws against fear.
